integrity: The proof is a direct laminar-family argument with a matching three-type blow-up showing sharpness. Exhaustive enumeration of all laminar binary relations with both sides of size at most four independently checks the one-third conclusion in the tested range. The motivating 2026 source was inspected at its definitions, prior explicit bounds, and full strong Erdos-Hajnal proof; targeted searches did not locate the sharp one-third statement.
scientific_limitations: The exact constant is for (2,1)-semi-equations, equivalently laminar fibre systems. No sharper general constant is claimed for k >= 3 or for arbitrary Boolean combinations.
title: Sharp one-third strong Erdős–Hajnal constant for laminar semi-equations
